dhp290:1:
If, by forsaking
a limited ease,
dhp290:2:
he would see
an abundance of ease,
dhp290:3:
the enlightened man
would forsake
the limited ease
dhp290:4:
for the sake
of the abundant.
dhp291:3:
Intertwined in the inter-
action of hostility,
dhp291:4:
from hostility
he’s not set free.
dhp292:1:
In those who
reject what should,
dhp293:1:
But for those who
are well-applied,
dhp293:2:
constantly,
to mindfulness immersed in the body;
dhp293:3:
don’t indulge
in what shouldn’t be done;
dhp296:4:
is constantly immersed
in the Buddha.
dhp297:4:
is constantly immersed
in the Dhamma.
dhp298:4:
is constantly immersed
in the Sangha.
dhp299:4:
is constantly immersed
in the body.
dhp300:3: whose hearts delight, both day & night,
dhp301:3: whose hearts delight, both day & night,
dhp302:1:
Hard
is the life gone forth,
hard to delight in.
dhp302:2:
Hard
is the miserable
householder’s life.
dhp302:3:
It’s painful
to stay with dissonant people,
dhp303:1:
The man of conviction
endowed with virtue,
dhp304:3:
The bad don’t appear
even when near,
dhp304:4: like arrows shot into the night.
dhp305:4:
he’d delight alone–
alone in the forest.
